# Agent Code Academy

> A free 12-week course teaching AI-assisted coding with Claude Code. Go from zero coding knowledge to building real applications.

## Course Overview

- URL: https://agentcodeacademy.com
- Format: Self-paced online course, 12 weeks, 3 phases
- Cost: Free (Weeks 1-4), Pro $49 (Weeks 1-12)
- Prerequisites: None — designed for complete beginners
- Tech Stack: Claude Code, Terminal, Git, React, Next.js, Databases, MCP Servers

## Phase 1: Foundation (Weeks 1-4)

- [Week 1: Your First AI Coding Session](https://agentcodeacademy.com/week/1): Terminal basics, Claude Code setup, first commands
- [Week 2: Building with Conversations](https://agentcodeacademy.com/week/2): Prompt engineering, iterative development
- [Week 3: Version Control with Git](https://agentcodeacademy.com/week/3): Git fundamentals, GitHub, branching
- [Week 4: Your First Web App](https://agentcodeacademy.com/week/4): HTML, CSS, JavaScript, deploying to Vercel

## Phase 2: Building (Weeks 5-8)

- [Week 5: React Fundamentals](https://agentcodeacademy.com/week/5): Components, props, state, JSX
- [Week 6: Full-Stack with Next.js](https://agentcodeacademy.com/week/6): Pages, routing, API routes, server components
- [Week 7: Databases & APIs](https://agentcodeacademy.com/week/7): SQL, ORMs, REST APIs, authentication
- [Week 8: Testing & Quality](https://agentcodeacademy.com/week/8): Unit tests, E2E tests, CI/CD, code review

## Phase 3: Mastery (Weeks 9-12)

- [Week 9: Advanced Claude Code](https://agentcodeacademy.com/week/9): Custom commands, hooks, subagents, CLAUDE.md
- [Week 10: MCP Servers](https://agentcodeacademy.com/week/10): Model Context Protocol, building custom tools
- [Week 11: AI Agent Development](https://agentcodeacademy.com/week/11): Multi-agent systems, orchestration
- [Week 12: Capstone Project](https://agentcodeacademy.com/week/12): Full application build, deployment, portfolio
